summary: Claude Startups gives approved founders $1,000 in Claude API credits, a free year of Claude Team for up to five Premium seats if they are new to Team, and access to up to $45,000 in partner offers. API credits expire six months after they are granted and apply only to the first-party Claude API through Claude Console.
claim_steps: Create a Claude Console account with a company email matching your website's domain.
Apply at https://claude.com/programs/startups and provide a short description of what you are building.
Meet the eligibility criteria: your startup was founded within the last five years or funded within the last two years.
After approval, sign in to the Claude Startups page in Claude Console to claim the API credits and Team offer.
